removed_canvas_notes: Human-readable names are presentation aliases; native identifiers remain unchanged beneath each name. No CCS expansion or undocumented payload fields are invented.
Four unique allocations appear twice each in the symmetric selected matrix (8 marked cells). Parent counts are totals, not extra allocations.
2011 figure and 2023 formal archive remain separate sources; four named endpoint pairings agree. No whole-model equivalence claim.

ASMLCS_Control_if is a UML Interface definition. logical.controlContract is an introduced representative port usage typed by a v2 port definition; this explicit view-context lift is not a lossless interface migration.

Archive imData, fpCtrlLan and fpImcsLan are public UML ProxyPorts; ccs and tcp/ip are public UML ports with no applied port stereotype found. The v2 plain-port projection preserves allocation endpoints, not complete proxy/interface semantics. Protocol operations and payloads are outside this matrix.

The source figure also shows an empty repeated AsmLCS group/unnamed-port row. Its exact archived identity is unresolved. It is retained as a source-only annotation, without inventing an extra physical port or allocation. Blank cells mean no selected modeled allocation.

LAN and protocol groups are introduced view contexts corresponding to source definitions; source owner IDs, visibility and implicit multiplicities are retained in mapping. No private part is made public.
Only typed allocation correspondence is upgraded; no operational connectivity or protocol compatibility is proved.
